key.name: hover-delay-ms
key.description: Delay before the preview popup appears after the pointer enters a dock icon.

key.name: preview-layout
key.description: Whether previews are arranged in a vertical stack or horizontal strip.

key.name: preview-width
key.description: Width of each preview thumbnail in pixels.

key.name: preview-height
key.description: Height of each preview thumbnail in pixels.

key.name: title-overflow-mode
key.description: Whether long window titles are truncated with ellipsis or wrapped to the next line.

key.name: middle-click-close
key.description: Whether middle-clicking a window preview closes that window.

key.name: show-close-button
key.description: Whether each hover preview shows a close button for closing the corresponding window.

key.name: close-button-position
key.description: Whether the preview close button is shown on the left or right side of the preview card.

key.name: maximize-to-new-workspace
key.summary: Maximize windows on a new workspace
key.description: Whether maximized application windows are moved to a dedicated workspace and returned when restored.

key.name: popup-fade-duration-ms
key.description: Duration of the fade-in/fade-out animation for the preview popup in milliseconds.

key.name: enriched-preview-enabled
key.description: When hovering a window preview item, show a larger centered preview after a delay.

key.name: enriched-preview-skip-focused
key.summary: Skip enriched preview for the focused window
key.description: Don't show the enriched preview when hovering the preview item of the window that already has focus.

key.name: enriched-preview-delay-ms
key.description: Delay before the enriched preview appears when hovering a window preview item (milliseconds).

key.name: enriched-preview-fade-duration-ms
key.description: Duration of the fade-in/fade-out animation for the enriched preview in milliseconds.

key.name: enriched-preview-size-percent
key.description: Maximum percentage of the monitor used by the centered enriched preview.

key.name: peek-enabled
key.description: Keep the hovered preview window visible while fading other windows.
